$comment: Single source of truth for the model catalog the cockpit offers, per coding-agent family.
Add a model as soon as it ships — no code change, no version bump: append it here and restart
the stack (systemctl --user restart shellteam-api shellteam-ai-chat). Both the Python control
plane (api/services/model_catalog.py — Fireworks proxy allowlist + OpenCode provider config)
and the Node cockpit (computer/ai-chat/lib/model-catalog.mjs — routing + dropdown) read this file.
match.prefixes drive model->agent routing (a model is also routed by exact membership in an
agent's models[] list). OpenCode models are Fireworks-hosted and proxied through the control
plane; each carries its upstream Fireworks id, so adding one only needs a line here.
'default' (OpenCode) is the model picked when the user selects the OpenCode family.
limit.context = the model's context window in tokens; the cockpit's context-budget meter
(renderContextMeter in public/app.js) shows usage against it. Claude values are the 1M window
Claude Code runs on a subscription (Haiku 4.5 stays 200K); the GPT-6 family is 1.05M
3.6 Flash ~1M. Verified against vendor docs + `agy models` 2026-07-23.

agents.label: Claude Code
$modelsComment: Ordered strongest→cheapest; the family default (DEFAULT_CLAUDE_MODEL in
computer/ai-chat/lib/constants.mjs) is Opus 5.5. Opus 5.5 (released 2026-09-22,
1M context, 128K output, $4/$20 per 1M tokens) replaced Opus 5 the day it shipped:
Fable-level on most work at 40% less than Opus 5 (platform.claude.com/docs/en/models/opus-5-5).
It needs Claude Code >= 2.1.280 — an older CLI answers every turn with a 400 that
names the required version (`claude update` fixes it); Fable 5.1, Sonnet 5 and Haiku 4.5
keep working on older CLIs. Verified 2026-09-22 on Claude Code 2.1.280 over a subscription.

agents.label: Codex
$modelsComment: GPT-6 family only. Astra (released 2026-09-03, $10/$50 per 1M tokens) is the
flagship; Sol (released 2026-09-22, $2/$10, 'balanced model for interactive and
agentic coding') is the family DEFAULT (DEFAULT_CODEX_MODEL in constants.mjs);
Luna (released 2026-09-22, $0.10/$0.50) is the cheap tier. All three: 1.05M
context, 128K output, efforts none..max per developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/.
The GPT-5.6 family was retired the day Sol and Luna shipped: each GPT-6 model
beats its 5.6 namesake at half the price with 2.6x the context, so the 5.6 entries
were strictly worse on every axis the dropdown shows. Tabs pinned to a retired id
migrate to the family default (resolveModelId in computer/ai-chat/lib/model-catalog.mjs).
Every entry pins an explicit reasoning effort via a model_reasoning_effort `-c`
override (`ultra` runs 4 parallel agents; `max` is the top single-agent effort).
Needs Codex CLI >= 0.156.0: on 0.153.x the server refused gpt-6-sol / gpt-6-luna
on a ChatGPT login ('not supported when using Codex with a ChatGPT account') and
the CLI warned it had no metadata for them; on 0.156.0 both answer. Verified
2026-09-22 on codex-cli 0.156.0 against a ChatGPT login: sol max, sol ultra,
luna max, astra max all answer; sol and luna also answer on a plain API key.

agents.label: Antigravity
agents.$comment: Google Antigravity CLI (`agy`). `cli` = the exact --model display name agy expects (from `agy models`); the cockpit id stays a clean slug. Non-streaming: one JSON envelope per turn, resume via --conversation.

agents.label: OpenCode (included)
$modelsComment: Ordered default-first, then strongest→cheapest; the dropdown renders this
array top-to-bottom. Every id/contextLength here was read from the Fireworks
control plane (GET https://api.fireworks.ai/v1/accounts/fireworks/models/<name>,
which also reports supportsTools) and each price from that model's
fireworks.ai page, verified 2026-08-31. cost is $/1M tokens and drives the
cockpit's spend readout — omitting it makes a paid model report $0.00, so
keep it filled in.
'default' is glm-5p3 (owner call, 2026-08-31): near-frontier coding at 3.4x
less than Kimi K3's output price, on the box owner's own Fireworks key — the
right landing spot for someone with no Claude/Codex subscription. K3 stays
one click away as the premium pick. glm-5p3-flash is the budget tier at a
tenth of GLM 5.3's input price.
K3 reasons on every request and its completion budget must cover the
reasoning trace as well as the answer, hence a larger limit.output than the
others — half Moonshot's 131072 default, which caps a runaway turn near $1.
The list is a short menu of models worth picking, not an archive: GLM 5.2
was dropped the day 5.3 shipped here (as 5.1 was for 5.2, and K2.6 for K3),
since a superseded model is strictly worse on every axis the dropdown shows.
Tabs pinned to a dropped id migrate to this family's default (resolveModelId
in computer/ai-chat/lib/model-catalog.mjs), so dropping one is safe.
